content.content: 0 <= pos <= markers.length(); a marker file where the position is outside that range is not a valid marker file and refuses the invocation.
content.rationale: The schema admits any position and says so: the `0 <= pos <= length` rule is left out of the schema and enforced at run time by the marker guards, which refuse a file that breaks it; the model invariants state the same bound. The linear history fixes the position this bounds (kpptprql). S5-marker-corrupt fixes that a file which cannot be read as a valid marker file refuses, and T-state the variables this bounds. The bound is claimed here, where a reader of the file can act on it, rather than left to a schema comment.
